name: 皮波拉·齿钳
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_三_繁荣的年月.md:3542
gear: 传奇（撼世，约630年到顶）｜中（风车灯镇修磨的匠人）｜照常（匠人的行头）｜5档｜深井这一段她已经是撼世，传奇写这一纪顶上那一身，样子照磨坊匠人的工装往上长，招牌是比前臂还长的齿钳和指节上一圈圈的金环。
who: Pipora Gearpincer, a goblin millwright of the windmill-lamp town, a legend called Wind-Grip, whose name was fixed at twenty-two when she held a reversed mill axle for three days and nights; she has looked just grown-up ever since: about 119 cm, small-boned and light enough to slip into the gap under a millstone. Pale sage-green skin. Bright yellow curly hair tied up in one short tuft. Lake-blue eyes. A pair of long pointed ears swept back. Sweets in her pockets, the wrappers kept well away from any gear. No earrings, no glasses. A quick, practical, mischievous air; she listens for the last sound a turning axle makes before it stops.
face: FACE, as in the references: a young goblin woman's face, just grown up, NOT a child's: large bright lake-blue eyes with a thin dark upper lash line, thin lively brows, a small pointed nose, a wide mouth that grins with the lips closed; the long pointed ears swept back from the head. Clean pale sage-green skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft cool green.
build: 119 cm, small and light-boned, a slim small frame.
palette: bright yellow, lake blue, sage green, millwright brown canvas, glowing gold
casual: Her millwright's work clothes: a short brown canvas work jacket with many pockets and the sleeves rolled to the elbow, a striped sweet wrapper peeking out of one pocket, over a long-sleeved mustard linen shirt; sturdy canvas trousers tucked into small hobnailed boots; a broad tool belt with wooden wedges and a little oil can; the long toothed pincer, longer than her forearm, hangs at her belt. She holds out a wrapped sweet in one hand as if about to slip it into someone's sleeve, a sly grin with the lips closed.
private: At home behind the mill: a loose long-sleeved yellow wool sweater, brown trousers, thick knitted socks, the tuft of hair let down. She holds a folded square of old torn sailcloth in both hands, a fond, amused look.
battle: Seizing the reversed axle, in a legend's millwright war harness: a fitted short coat of dark rune-stitched canvas over a breastplate of mountain-copper plates riveted like the housing of a great gear, small brass cogs set at both shoulders turning slowly with a gold glow, thick leather gauntlets with purified deep-floor ether crystals at the knuckles, a tool belt of brass-capped wedges. She grips the long toothed pincer in both hands, its jaws biting a ring of glowing brass, and rings of small golden light climb from her knuckles up both forearms like the coils of a spring; a thin white streak of wind circles her. A fierce, focused look.
formal: Honoured at the guild when her name went into the book: a fitted dark mustard wool frock coat cut small for her, brass buttons shaped like little gears, a white shirt with a neat cravat, dark trousers, polished small boots; the toothed pincer polished and hung at her hip on a leather loop. She stands straight with her hands clasped behind her, a slightly embarrassed grin.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the lake-blue eyes looking up at the viewer with a quick grin, one hand raised beside a long ear as she listens to a turning axle. Warm golden light through the slats of a windmill from one side, pale streaks of wind on the other. Foreground blur: whirling chaff, the teeth of a wooden gear wheel and a twist of bright sweet wrapper. She wears the brown canvas work jacket.

name: 茵若薇·湖织

gear: 传奇（撼世，约648年凝名到顶）｜中（替渔户结网补网的人家）｜法袍（湖岸观测营学看水的，两只手压湖，不使兵器）｜5档｜传奇不看家境，她不拿兵器，战装写成观测营的长袍、贝母胸甲和网结的披肩，料子用这一纪顶上的。
who: Inrovie Lakeweave, a human of the mirror-lake kingdom from a family who knot and mend nets for the fishers of the great Starmirror lake, a legend called the Still-Lake Mirror, whose name was fixed at twenty-eight when she pressed the whole lake flat for three nights; she has looked twenty-eight ever since: tall, about 174 cm, slender. Raven-black hair with a deep blue sheen, long, coiled at the back of her head. Lake-green eyes, clear to the bottom. Under her right eye (on the viewer's left when she faces us) a faint pale thin line, like a far shoreline of waves when she blinks. No earrings, no glasses. A patient, quiet, attentive air; she always looks once more before she speaks.
face: FACE, as in the references: a calm woman's face of twenty-eight: medium almond eyes of clear lake green with a thin dark upper lash line; level fine brows; under her right eye (on the viewer's left) a faint pale thin line like a distant wave line; a small closed mouth. Clean fair skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft cool blue.
build: 174 cm, tall and slender, long-limbed: a medium bust, a narrow waist and gently rounded hips.
palette: deep lake blue, lake green, blue-black, net-cord ivory, a little silver
casual: Her lakeshore clothes: a long deep-blue wool dress closing down the front with small horn buttons, fitted long sleeves, the hem cut to clear the ankles; a short ivory knitted shawl over the shoulders; soft-soled water boots of oiled leather; a wooden netting needle and a hank of net cord at her belt. She holds a small clay cup with a crack in its rim, one finger slowly turning it, a quiet, listening look.
private: At the lake observation camp at night: a long loose dark grey-blue wool dress, a thick ivory knitted shawl, soft house shoes, the coiled hair loosened a little. She holds the cracked clay cup in both hands near her chest, a faint, contented look.
battle: Pressing the whole lake flat, in a legend's lake-warden regalia: a long deep-blue coat-robe of rune-stitched water-silk closing down the front with pale shell buttons, fitted sleeves, over a slim breastplate of mother-of-pearl plates edged in silver whose engraved ripple lines shine lake green; over her shoulders a short mantle knotted like a fine fishing net of glowing silver cord, a small purified deep-floor ether crystal at every knot; tall waterproof boots. Both palms are held flat and low in front of her, and calm rings of light spread outward through the air from her hands like ripples. Still, steady, unyielding.
formal: Before the lakeshore folk on the day they named her: a long fitted deep-blue wool gown with a high collar, silver-thread net embroidery along the hem and cuffs, long fitted sleeves, a pale grey shawl, the coiled hair pinned with a plain silver net-shaped pin, soft shoes. She stands upright with the hands folded in front, a calm, grave look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the lake-green eyes looking just past the viewer as if at far water, one fingertip resting on the cracked rim of a small cup held near her chin. Cool silver-grey lake light and fog from one side, a thousand tiny boat lanterns reflected on mirror-still water far behind. Foreground blur: drifting fog, a loose net cord and the edge of flat shining water. She wears the long deep-blue dress.

Short pale-gold hair. Sky-blue eyes. A slanting scar across the bridge of his nose from a fall off a stable roof as a boy. When he grins, one slightly pointed canine shows on one side. No earrings. build: 186 cm, tall, long-legged and broad-shouldered, a rider's lean strength.
palette: kite white, pale gold, sky blue, saddle brown, polished steel
casual: His day clothes among the rope crews: a short white-and-sky-blue riding jacket with a high collar, closing down the front with brass buttons, a gold kite badge with spread wings on the left breast; buff leather riding breeches, tall brown riding boots, riding gloves tucked into the belt; a coil of light rope over one shoulder. He holds a wooden griffin feeding bowl under one arm, a teasing grin.
private: Off duty at the rope crews' shed: a loose white linen shirt with the sleeves rolled, braces, buff trousers, worn riding boots. He holds a pair of griffin claw-clippers in one hand and a long white feather in the other, laughing with the lips closed.
battle: Holding up the snapped cables, in a legendary White Kite sky-knight's harness: fitted white enamelled plate over fine glowing mail, the breastplate engraved with a gold kite with spread wings whose lines shine sky blue, swept wing-shaped pauldrons, articulated gauntlets with rope-grip palms, a short sky-blue cape lined white streaming back; a safety line of rune-lit cord clipped at the waist; purified deep-floor ether crystals glow along the sword's spine. He holds the straight longsword, NOT a curved sword, its point thrust through a heavy iron ring, while thin white lines glow along his spine and collarbones. A fierce, laughing set of the jaw.
formal: At the order's hall: a long white wool frock coat with a stand collar and gold piping, a sky-blue sash across the chest, a gold kite brooch with spread wings, white gloves, polished tall boots, the straight sword in a white scabbard at his hip. He stands straight with both hands resting on the sword hilt, a relaxed, warm smile.
art: A portrait from slightly below with the camera tilted, the face large, the sky-blue eyes looking down at the viewer with a teasing grin, one gloved hand reaching down as if to pull someone up. Bright wind and white light high above a misty gorge from one side. Foreground blur: the edge of a huge white griffin wing, a taut cable and drifting white feathers. He wears the white-and-sky-blue riding jacket.

name: 邓巴尔·熔胡

who: Dunbar Meltbeard, a dwarf of a furnace-keeping family of the Red Forge wall-town, a legend called the Sunken Fire, whose name was fixed at a hundred and twenty-two when he led a runaway city furnace down into the bedrock for three days; he has looked about forty ever since: short, about 138 cm, deep-chested, his forearms thicker than another man's calves, standing like a block of iron chiselled with shoulders. A broad face. Fiery red hair cropped short, and a fiery red beard parted into three thick strands, the tips curled by the forge. Two streaks of grey-white at the temples. Warm amber eyes. An old little iron cage on a chain, used for roasting chestnuts. A hearty, practical air; his beard shakes before his laugh comes.
face: FACE, as in the references: a dwarf man's face of about forty, broad and strong, NOT young: deep-set warm amber eyes, heavy red brows, a broad nose, cheeks ruddy from the forge heat, the mouth half hidden in a three-strand red beard with curled tips; two grey-white streaks at the temples. Clean fair skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft warm red-orange.
build: 138 cm, short and massive: a barrel chest, thick shoulders and enormous forearms.
palette: fire red, forge orange, soot black, iron grey, a little gold
casual: His furnace-worker's clothes: a thick leather apron scorched in patches over a sleeveless dark wool tunic, bare forearms, a broad belt with tongs and a soot rag, heavy iron-capped boots; the little old iron cage on a chain at his hip with a few chestnuts in it. He rests a short forge hammer on one shoulder, a hearty grin under the beard.
private: Roasting chestnuts at home: a loose rust-brown wool shirt with the sleeves pushed up, braces, dark trousers, felt slippers. He holds the little iron cage of chestnuts in one hand and a cracked-open chestnut in the other, a contented look.
battle: Sinking the runaway fire into the rock, in a legend's forge-warden war harness: heavy plate of dark mountain-copper riveted like a furnace door, every seam glowing deep red as if the metal held live coals, a thick scorched leather apron belted over it, massive gauntlets with ether crystals at the knuckles; the iron boots are left off and his feet are bare, lines of white-gold fire running down from his knees into his soles. He swings a great forge hammer in both hands, its head ringed with molten-gold runes, white flame streaming from it. The beard bristling, a fierce, steady look.
formal: When his name went into the guild's book: a long dark red wool coat with a stand collar and brass buttons, a black waistcoat, the beard freshly braided in three strands each closed with a copper ring, polished boots, the hammer left at home. He stands with his hands clasped in front, a gruff, embarrassed grin.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the amber eyes crinkled in a laugh, the three-strand red beard catching the light, one hand raised holding a roasted chestnut. Deep orange forge light from below and one side, sparks rising. Foreground blur: glowing coals, the bars of the little iron cage and drifting embers. He wears the scorched leather apron.

name: 阿贝丽娜·绯盏
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_四_深井的年月.md:5999
gear: 传奇（撼世，约777年凝名到顶）｜富（替商船挑宴席的酒，出手阔）｜照常（不使兵器，靠杯子和血里装得下的光）｜5档｜西边绯宴的魔族，战装写成酒红丝绒长外套配黑曜钢细胸甲、金丝高领，招牌是那只空杯；凝名那一件是划开掌心，照安全审核写成掌心一道红光。
who: Abelina Crimsoncup, a demon-kin woman of the crimson-feast folk who chose the banquet wines for the merchant ships of the dark river, a legend called the Cup of Light-Dust, whose name was fixed at seventy-seven when she drank three days of drifting light-dust out of the air over the river; her folk stay in their twenties once grown, and she looks about twenty-five: tall, about 176 cm, slender. Pale white skin. Deep red eyes. Long hair the dark red of silk soaked in wine. Pointed ears, each hung with a gold earring, the two not a pair: a small gold hoop on the left, a gold teardrop on the right. Since her name was fixed, the veins at her wrists show a very faint blue-white glow. No horns. A warm, teasing, food-loving air; she says 'let me taste' first.
face: FACE, as in the references: a woman's face of about twenty-five, warm and teasing: deep red almond eyes with a thin dark upper lash line, fine arched dark-red brows, a small straight nose, a mouth with a sly closed-lip smile; pointed ears with a small gold hoop in the left ear and a gold teardrop in the right. Clean pale skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft cool rose.
build: 176 cm, tall and slender: long limbs, a medium bust, a narrow waist and gently rounded hips.
palette: wine red, porcelain white, gold, blue-white glow, dark river teal
casual: Her riverboat wine-buyer's clothes: a fitted wine-red velvet waistcoat over a white silk shirt with full long sleeves buttoned at the wrist, a dark teal ankle-length skirt, soft dark boots; a small silver tasting cup on a fine chain at her belt. private: Seasick on a river boat at night: a loose long-sleeved cream linen dress, a dark red shawl, soft slippers, the hair loose. She holds a bowl of warm salted water in both hands, wrinkling her nose, a grudging smile.
battle: Drinking the river's light-dust, in a legend's crimson-feast war regalia: a long fitted wine-red coat of rune-stitched velvet over a slim breastplate of black obsidian-steel filigreed with gold, a high collar of gold lacework, red-lacquered gauntlets that leave the right palm bare; a chain of tiny gold cups and wine-red crystals at the belt. She raises an empty gold-rimmed glass cup in her right hand, a thin line of red light across the bare palm beneath it, and ribbons of glittering blue-white light-dust stream through the air into the cup; her wrists and throat glow blue-white under the skin. A calm, daring smile.
formal: At a merchants' banquet: a long wine-red silk gown with a high lace collar and long fitted sleeves, a gold chain belt, black gloves, the mismatched gold earrings. She holds a crystal wine glass by the stem, a gracious, amused look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the deep red eyes looking at the viewer over the rim of an empty cup, a teasing smile, the faint blue-white glow showing at her wrist. Night on a river: the cold blue-white shimmer of drifting light-dust from one side, warm ship-lantern light from the other. Foreground blur: glittering motes of light-dust, the gold rim of a cup and the edge of a mooring rope. She wears the wine-red velvet waistcoat.

name: 姬特·数辙
src: 迷宫纪前传/补卷/补卷_20_遗物的原主_一.md:5
gear: 传奇（撼世，821年从第五十五层上来那一刻到传奇）｜中（数辙家替车队点数）｜照常（领路的，样子实用）｜5档｜五个人靠凑齐不靠谁厉害，战装用这一纪顶上的料子、样子照向导的实用打扮；手里那把单手剑是回来以后拿第五十五层那批偏青的料打的五缕布（★）。
who: Kit Countrut, a halfling from the honey-mead hills whose family counts the carts of the long caravans, who walked three years knocking on four doors to gather her party and brought all five back from the fifty-fifth floor, a legend called the Door-Knocker; thirty-eight in this year and keeping that look ever since: about 100 cm, reaching a human's waist, small and round. Primrose-yellow short curly hair cut at the ears. Blue-green eyes. A small bone flute with five holes hangs on a leather cord at her throat, the fifth hole sealed with wax. A bronze star-chart rank emblem at her chest. No earrings, no glasses. A brisk, warm, counting air; she keeps looking back to count heads.
palette: primrose yellow, blue-green, bone ivory, caravan russet, five faded cloth colours
casual: Her guild guide's clothes: a short russet travelling coat with deep pockets and the sleeves turned back, a cream linen shirt buttoned up, brown wool trousers, sturdy laced boots; the bronze star-chart rank emblem pinned on the chest; the bone flute on its cord at her throat. She holds up one hand with four fingers spread, counting heads, a brisk, warm smile.
private: Off duty: a long-sleeved knitted mustard sweater, brown trousers, soft shoes. She turns the bone flute in her fingers, her thumb on the wax-sealed hole, a quiet, wistful smile.
battle: Leading the five down to the fifty-fifth floor, in a legend's dungeon-guide war kit made to her size: a fitted coat of rune-stitched blue-grey leather over a light breastplate of pale blue-green deep-floor metal whose edges glow faintly, small articulated pauldrons, a belt of brass-capped pouches; the star-chart rank emblem shines at her chest. In her right hand a single-handed straight sword of blue-green metal, five strips of different faded cloth wound round its hilt; her left hand lifts the bone flute to her lips. Alert, steady, counting.
formal: Before the stone-cutter who carves the depth stones: a neat dark green wool frock coat cut small, brass buttons, a cream shirt and a small cravat, brown trousers, polished boots, the bone flute on its cord. She stands straight with her hands clasped in front, a proud, shy smile.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the blue-green eyes looking back over her shoulder at the viewer as if counting, the bone flute held near her lips. Warm lantern light from one side, the deep blue dark of the dungeon behind. Foreground blur: a few scattered dry beans, five strips of faded cloth and drifting dust. She wears the short russet travelling coat.
